newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC seen raising barley carryover stock.
newsitem.headline: ONIC seen raising barley carryover stock.

text.p: France's ONIC provisionally plans to increase its barley carryover stock forecast to 874,000 tonnes from 829,000 tonnes, industry sources said on Monday.
The figures were drafted for a monthly report due to be published on Wednesday but can be fine-tuned before release.
The change is mostly on the supply side, where ONIC sees provisions to the market (after on-farm consumption) at 7.68 million tonnes instead of 7.62 million published last month.
Total usage is seen fractionally higher at 6.806 million tonnes. But within this total ONIC plans to juggle export forecasts to show more leaving the EU, the sources said.

Confirming initial indications on Friday, they said ONIC would increase its forecast for barley exports to third countries in 1996/97 (July/June) to 1.6 million tonnes from a previous estimate of 1.5 million tonnes.
Exports to European Union countries would be shaved to 2.370 million tonnes from 2.455 million, however.
ONIC does not comment on its figures before publication.
